source.statement: Decision EA-008-TEXT-BORDER-2026-11-20 resolves the recorded regular Text border geometry question: the border strokes the text box - a rounded rectangle around the text area with corner radius 4, drawn with the border colour at max(1, stroke width), centred on the box edge, after the background fill and behind the text - and never outlines glyphs. Source: ShareX's reference DrawText (ShareX.ImageEffectsLib/Drawings/DrawText.cs), which draws background, then border (the same rounded-rectangle path stroked with BorderColor at max(1, BorderSize), CornerRadius default 4), then the text; its only glyph-level extra is the optional offset DrawTextShadow duplicate, a separate feature this decision does not add, and the reference TextAnnotation carries no outline at all. The earlier native glyph-outline candidate matched no reference surface and is replaced, not approved: the textBorderColor field keeps its name, parsing, persistence, alpha semantics and edit/history behavior, and the pixels it drives become the decided box outline. EditorCanvasTest::textBorderStrokesTheTextBoxPerTheDecidedGeometry pins the geometry with region discriminators (border pixels on top and side edges where no glyph reaches; text pixels exactly unchanged), proven red against the pre-change glyph-outline code via a saved patch, green after, with the whole suite passing 183/183. The SpeechBalloon's separate balloonBorderColor body/tail outline is untouched. The other fifteen packages carry forward to contract 0.4.4 unchanged in normative text from 0.4.3, where the 2026-11-20 EA-009 record approved them; the deciding agent verified that carry-forward by inspecting this commit's diff, which touches no other capability package. No ROOT constitution rule is changed.
